Just weeks after announcing a price hike for Apple Music, Apple announced today (16th) that Apple TV+ monthly fees will also increase. The company confirmed to 9to5Mac that Apple TV+ monthly fees will rise from US$12.99 to US$14.99 (approximately HK$117).

The Apple One Individual plan monthly fee will also be raised simultaneously.

Apple TV+ and Apple One price increases

Price increase details as follows:

  • Apple TV+ (monthly): US$14.99 (originally US$12.99)
  • Apple TV+ (annual): US$119 (originally US$99)
  • Apple One Individual: US$21.95 (originally US$19.95)

Other Apple One plan prices remain unchanged. When Apple raised Apple Music monthly fees last month, it also simultaneously raised the Apple One Family and Apple One Premier plan monthly fees, although the Individual plan price was not adjusted at that time.

The new pricing takes effect immediately for new subscribers. Apple stated that existing subscribers will be notified of the price increase arrangements approximately one month before the new charges take effect.

Apple last adjusted Apple TV+ monthly fees in August last year, raising the price from US$9.99 to US$12.99. That price increase did not adjust the annual plan or Apple One bundle pricing.

Apple has significantly expanded its Apple TV+ content lineup over the past year. In October last year, Apple announced it had become the exclusive broadcast partner for F1 racing in the United States. F1 race live streaming is now included in the standard Apple TV+ subscription at no extra charge.

Earlier this year, Apple also added Major League Soccer (MLS) live streaming to the Apple TV+ platform, also at no extra charge. Previously, watching MLS matches required a separate MLS Season Pass subscription.

Apple is also benefiting from the recent successful launches of several programmes, such as the fourth season of "Ted Lasso". Apple TV+ also premiered the second season of "Dark Matter" today. The sixth season of "Slow Horses" will premiere on 16 September.

What are your thoughts on the new Apple TV+ monthly fee? At US$14.99 per month, is Apple TV+ content worth the price? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
